name: Ahrefs
summary: An SEO and search-data vendor whose documentation names three agent paths: a hosted MCP server (api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp) on paid plans from Lite, with selectable tool groups for site audit, keyword research, backlinks, rank tracking, Google Search Console and AI-search visibility; a REST API v3 metered in API units; and Ahrefs Connect, an OAuth program for third-party apps. Account-bound: the vendor's own page forbids standalone HTTP/JSON-RPC clients on the MCP endpoint, so no keyless initialize was sent; the API's free crawler-IP endpoint answered 200 keyless and a metered endpoint 403.

payments.notes: 2026-11-06: no surface prices an MCP or API call in money; calls spend API units included in a plan (pricing page: Lite $129, Standard $249, Advanced $449, Enterprise $1,499 a month, each listing API and MCP access); the terms charge the payment method on file, plus pay-as-you-go units.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-06, no credentials: the MCP endpoint was not called, because the vendor's page forbids standalone JSON-RPC clients; its OAuth metadata read 200 and names a registration endpoint and the scope apiv3-mcp. API: public/crawler-ips 200 at 0 units; site-explorer 403, no challenge header.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: its MCP "automates a wide range of SEO and marketing tasks like keyword research, competitive analysis, backlink audits, content planning, content gap analysis, on-page SEO recommendations". No page read says it changes a page: it audits and measures; measured by nobody else.
